title: Clicker Indoctrination
description:
Hello, Sweeteas!
My very first clicker-training audio! This one is a bit different than the usual, however. There is a relatively long induction suited for beginners and experienced subjects alike, which takes you down so deep that you may lost sight of where your mind ends and where my hypnosis begins. It’s full of fun sounds and empty thoughts.
Then…I condition you to feel sensations barely of this world upon hearing the sound of a clicker (be it my own or someone else’s). It’s not just arousal. It’s everything. The the entire spectrum of positive emotions and sensations. You become the fulcrum of all that is good in the world. All that is pleasure. All that is perfect. It’s so much more than just horny.
The more you listen, the more conditioned you become, and the better the clicks make you feel, so the power of the trigger will depend mostly on you. But…even a single listen should break apart your mind and melt you down into an existence only aware of one thing: how good it can feel to experience true bliss.
So listen and transcend your body, your mind, and your joy.
Have fun~
